rules.statement: The discretionary power to register an instrument in a new folio under Section 14(1) of the Registration of Documents Ordinance must be exercised only when registration according to the rule laid down in the main section is not feasible, or in special circumstances such as registering a final decree of partition.
rules.supporting_quote: "The discretionary power conferred on the Registrar by the proviso must be exercised only in a case where registration according to the rule laid down in the main section is not feasible, or in a case in which the entry in a new folio is proper in the special circumstances of a case, e.g., when registering a final decree of partition"
